title: Stationary Strings Theorem V: Arrest of the September 2026 Navier-Stokes Vortex Singularity by Elastic String Tension, X to 0 Axis Regularization and Self-Consistent Saturation Proof
description: Numerical verification (SciPy Radau/DOP853/brentq, 1e-14 tolerance, tests T1-T12) of elastic-string arrest of the September 2026 Navier-Stokes vortex singularity: explicit-model arrest scales, self-consistent saturation, Cartesian X to 0 axis regularization, acoustic horizon map, and topological invariant conservation at machine precision. Full paper in Turkish and English plus solver package (solver code under MIT).
